evidence.reason: The finding asks to reject an empty `--only` value before matching, since `includes('')` would silently select every cell and turn a targeted rerun into a full run. The current file already implements exactly that: lines 21-31 add an explicit `only === ''` check and throw a usage error ('--only requires a value') before the match/filter, and line 32 only filters after the check. The supplied history records commit b74de0c2891aff4762e4ec4b23dc38a62bcac619 ('reject-empty-only-value-before-matching'), which is the change that introduced this guard. The defect as alleged no longer exists at the tip.
